author: Maxinoxo
body: Hello, I'm Maxinoxo and I have come here to appeal my ban on Avicus. I am a French player that was looking forward into joining a team until I made a big mistake by advertising a different server in chat. I am very sorry for advertising on the Avicus Network. If you could give me a second chance that would mean a lot to me, and I will promise to not do that dumb idea again.

title: Hello Staff

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to accept your appeal because you have waited seven months as a banned user. However, if you are banned again, your chances of appealing your punishment will be decreased significantly. Be sure to read the rules (http://avicus.net/rules) and welcome back to the server!
          
Regards,
Rinn
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
